name: fastify-ledger
description: Scalable double-entry bookkeeping ledger built with Fastify + postgres.js

scripts.db:migrate: docker exec -i ledger-postgres psql -U postgres -d ledger < migrations/001_init.sql && docker exec -i ledger-postgres psql -U postgres -d ledger < migrations/002_initial_balance.sql
scripts.db:reset: docker-compose down -v && docker-compose up -d postgres && sleep 5 && npm run db:migrate
scripts.docker:up:direct: docker-compose up -d postgres app && npm run db:migrate
scripts.docker:up:pgbouncer: APP_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:ledger@pgbouncer:5432/ledger docker-compose up -d postgres pgbouncer app && npm run db:migrate
scripts.test:load: k6 run -e TARGET_RPS=400 -e MAX_VUS=600 -e PRE_ALLOCATED_VUS=120 tests/load/baseline.js
scripts.test:load:k8s: bash -lc 'set -e; kubectl -n ledger port-forward svc/ledger-api 13000:3000 >/tmp/ledger-k8s-pf.log 2>&1 & PF=$!; trap "kill $PF >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" EXIT; sleep 2; BASE_URL=http://localhost:13000 k6 run -e TARGET_RPS=400 -e MAX_VUS=600 -e PRE_ALLOCATED_VUS=120 tests/load/baseline.js'
